title: Theorem 3: optimal finite-field Kakeya lower bound C_n q^n
statement_scope: Whole unlabelled theorem at lines 197-201: let K subset F^n be a Kakeya set. Then |K| ≥ C_n · q^n, where C_n depends only on n. The proof at lines 202-221 is the author's written version of the argument credited to Noga Alon and Terence Tao at lines 191-196. The displayed contradiction threshold binom(q+n-2,n) at line 204 and every homogeneous-part step are retained verbatim; no genericity condition or extra assumption is added.

Homogeneous decomposition P=sum P_i and the fact that a univariate polynomial over F_q of degree at most q-1 vanishing at all q field elements is identically zero (lines 207-213).
